mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item ( order_id, sku_id, product_name, option_summary, quantity, unit_price, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{optionSummary}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT product_name AS productName, option_summary AS optionSummary, sku_id AS skuId, quantity AS quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity * unit_price AS lineAmount FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
